tests.reason: Banks fund home loans either directly or by lending to housing finance companies, so one channel substitutes for the other.
tests.note: Pre-registered as substitution (−); complement (+) was the alternative reading. Ad-hoc checks 2026-10-08: raw monthly new lending r=+0.46 p=0.03 (n=22) and YoY-change r=+0.52 p=0.04 (n=15), both explained by the shared bank-credit tide (housing vs total bank credit r=0.78); after removing it r=+0.17 p=0.43.

tests.reason: When construction firms borrow more, their main input suppliers' working capital rises too, within the same month.
tests.note: Family of 4 declared together 2026-10-08 before any result: Construction→Cement (main), Construction→Iron and Steel, CRE→Cement, CRE→Iron and Steel; all +, lag 0. Construction and Cement are siblings under Industry, a slight mechanical pull toward a negative link (against the prediction).
